purpose: Feed Kiln-emitted request bytes to Lattice's published lineage consumer without a Lattice dependency in Kiln

lattice.harness: a throwaway crate outside the Kiln tree with those files and Lattice's two-line is_blake3; it decodes each request's lineage member as lineage::Binding (deny_unknown_fields), then calls validate(), gate(Draws::default(), Draws{model_requests:1,tool_invocations:1}), unaccounted() and identity()

non_claims: the full lattice implementation-attempt run was not executed; only Lattice's lineage consumer read the bytes
the golden fixtures are asserted byte for byte by Kiln's own tests, which produced them from the in-memory ledger
